description:
STIEBEL ELTRON bietet hocheffiziente Produkte und Lösungen für Warmwasser, Wärme, Lüftung und Kühlung für jedes Gebäude. Dabei verfolgen wir eine klare Linie und treiben die Energiewende voran: Erneuerbarer Strom ist die Antriebsenergie unserer Produkte! Mit unseren über 5.000 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeitern setzen wir auf Innovationen und streben immer nach der besten Lösung. Wir kombinieren für unsere Kunden die Erfahrung aus 100 Jahren Warmwasserbereitung, fast 50 Jahren Wärmepumpentechnik und mehr als 30 Jahren Lüftungstechnik, um ihnen zukunftsweisende Systeme zu bieten. Sie beraten Kunden und unterstützen den Vertriebsinnendienst bei der Erstellung von Angeboten, wobei Sie einen großen Beitrag zum Erfolg der Objekte in Zusammenarbeit mit Architekten, Fachplanern und Fachhandwerkern leisten
Natürlich werden Sie dabei vom Vertriebsinnendienst und Vertriebscontrolling sowie unseren CRM-Tools und Reportings unterstützt
Ihr Profil:
Sie bringen mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Außendienst mit, zum Beispiel als Key Account Manager, Sales Manager oder Produktmanager im Außendienst

description:

description:
Über uns
Yes ist die Software für Vertriebsteams von FMCG-Marken im Lebensmitteleinzelhandel. Außendienst, Key Account und Vertriebsleitung arbeiten in einem System: Tourenplanung, Storechecks, Aktionen, Ziele und Auswertungen in Echtzeit. Zu unseren Kunden gehören unter anderem nucao, ahead und Uludağ.

Du bringst die Teams unserer Kunden produktiv ins System, bleibst danach ihre feste Ansprechperson und legst dabei selbst fest, wie Onboarding, Betreuung und Support bei Yes funktionieren. Du priorisierst selbst, was als Nächstes dran ist, und holst dir Abstimmung, wenn du sie brauchst, nicht für jeden Schritt.
Du findest pragmatische Lösungen, auch wenn Informationen fehlen oder für einen Fall noch kein Prozess existiert.
Du gehst Kundenprobleme bis zur Ursache nach, statt sie weiterzugeben, und arbeitest dich dafür auch in die Daten und das Produkt ein.
Du wechselst innerhalb eines Tages zwischen Schulung im Markt, Datenimport und Prozessarbeit, ohne den Überblick zu verlieren.
Du baust Abläufe beim ersten Mal so, dass sie beim zehnten Kunden noch funktionieren, und dokumentierst sie entsprechend.
Du sagst offen, wenn etwas nicht funktioniert, und bringst einen Vorschlag mit.

WORKBOX – Raum für Business. Und für gute Ideen.
WORKBOX bietet flexible Smart Business Spaces für Unternehmen, Start-ups, E-Commerce, Produktion, Kreative und Kleinhandwerk. An unseren Berliner Standorten schaffen wir Räume, in denen Menschen arbeiten, lagern, produzieren und ihr Business weiterentwickeln können.

title: Senior Customer Success Manager
description:
Industry leader? Well, how about an industry creator?!
WalkMe, an SAP company, pioneered the world's leading Digital Adoption Platform, helping organizations navigate change across any application or system. Today it is the platform that drives AI adoption across the enterprise. Enterprise work stays fragmented across applications, and that fragmentation compounds as AI advances. Traditional training and vendor-provided help leave organizations managing change one application at a time. WalkMe guides people through change, brings AI into the flow of work, automates tasks and shows executives how workflows perform. Global leaders including IBM, Nestlé, Thermo Fisher Scientific, and the U.S. federal government trust WalkMe. WalkMe turns AI potential into AI performance.
So, if you’re an expert in your field, and looking for an opportunity to work, collaborate, and innovate with some of the most talented people out there, WalkMe is the place for you!
We’re looking for a Senior Customer Success Manager, Commercially adept but with a technical curiosity in the Product and what it can do for our Customers, to help take digital adoption and WalkMe to the next level.
As a Customer Success Manager, you’ll be responsible for being a trusted advisor to a portfolio of around 10 Fortune 1000 WalkMe customers, helping them achieve maximum value from the WalkMe platform. You will understand your clients' digital adoption goals, and recommend technology solutions to help them get the most out of our product and meet/exceed their goals. You will report to the Manager of Customer Success.
What You'll Own
Be the 'voice of the customer' and provide internal feedback to maximize customer value and retention.
Schedule and prepare Executive Business Reviews for customers, with the top priority of increasing customer adoption and proving Return on Investment that leads to renewals/expansion.

description:

Key Account Manager (m/w/d)
Stellen-ID: 261055
Im Bereich Key Account Management bei Vodafone betreuen wir die größten, globalen agierenden Konzerne in internationalen, bereichsübergreifenden Teams. In dieser dynamischen Umgebung haben wir die einzigartige Gelegenheit, komplexe Projekte zu realisieren und wegweisende Lösungen, in Ergänzung zu den bisher gängigen Telekommunikationslösungen, zu verkaufen.
Unser Vertrieb ist geprägt von strategischem Denken, Flexibilität und der Fähigkeit, komplexe Probleme zu lösen. Unser Portfolio umfasst dabei unter anderem neben Mobilfunk- und Festnetzanwendungen auch IoT, Security-, UCC - & Netzwerklösungen.
Jeder Tag bringt neue Möglichkeiten und unerwartete Situationen mit sich, die es zu meistern gilt. Doch genau darin liegt der Reiz - die Chance, über sich hinauszuwachsen und Grenzen zu überschreiten. Wenn Du bereit bist, Dich neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen und Deine Karriere auf das nächste Level zu bringen, dann ist ein Job im Bereich Key Account Management bei Vodafone genau das Richtige für Dich. Sei Teil eines Teams, das jeden Tag neue Maßstäbe setzt. Deine Zukunft beginnt hier - are you ready?!

Du verantwortest als Key Account Manager (m/w/d) die nationale Umsatz- und Zielerreichungsverantwortung für die zugewiesenen Kund:innen.

title: Senior Account Executive Germany (f/m/d)
description:
At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money. Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.
We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.
ABOUT THE ROLE:
The Growth team at Upvest is driving our go-to-market activities, spanning across Marketing, Sales and Customer Success. Our mission is to become the Investment-as-a-service category leader for Europe's leading brokers, banks, wealth managers, and non-financial platforms. We're honoured to work with some of Europe's leading brands in a fast moving and expanding market already and are just getting started.
As Upvest enters the next stage of growth, we are seeking a highly motivated and outcome-driven Account Executive to join us. All our team efforts are centred around the client and give you the opportunity to work with high autonomy coupled with inspirational leadership. Working in the Growth team combines impactful work with a relaxed and fun atmosphere. We have established strong practices around feedback, team health and social events.
In this role, you will work directly with our Director Business Development DACH https://www.linkedin.com/in/alexander-reichhardt-87b6

title: Account Executive - Enterprise
description:
about us
Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.
For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.
AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.
At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.
We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.
Check out our principles to see how we work.

title: Customer Success Manager - Landwirtschaft
description:
🌎 WHAT WE DO
ROOT IS EUROPE’S 1 PRIMARY DATA COLLECTION PLATFORM FOR F&B COMPANIES. WE HELP OUR CUSTOMERS TO MEASURE AND REDUCE FARM-LEVEL EMISSIONS.
~31% of global GHG emissions originate from food-related activities. For the first time in history, climate performance has become an overall business performance indicator. Enterprises are mandated by regulatory bodies to disclose their climate performance, which leads to increasing pressure from investors, competitors, retailers, and consumers to prevent and reduce their CO2e emissions. Over the next 10 years, companies have set ambitious reduction targets that need to be met. Unlike other industries, the vast majority of F&B emissions originate from farms (known as Scope 3.1 emissions) and are highly complex to address. Root exists to help overcome this challenge.
We raised >€10m in funding in the first 2 years of our existence, we launched our enterprise product, signed and onboarded some of the largest F&B players in Europe, and put together what we believe is the best-suited early-stage tech team in Europe. Will you be the next to join us? 🚀

Ralph baut das Operating System für Wohnimmobilien. Der Markt ist riesig, und er läuft noch größtenteils auf Aktenordnern, Outlook und USB-Sticks. As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. Your work will help mitigate risks and ensure we’re positioned for sustainable, long-term success—making you a key contributor to our mission of delivering amazing experiences worldwide.

title: Account Executive - DACH
description:
ABOUT ANDERCORE
Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.
Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.
We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.
We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.
Where we are today:
- Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers
- Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond
- 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai
- $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW
The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

Company Overview
Hotel Res Bot is a fast-growing company helping hotels and travel agencies automate their inbound communications using self-trained AI.
Our platform is designed specifically for reservation and group sales teams, helping them manage and respond to high volumes of inbound email communication more efficiently and consistently.
We integrate with hotel systems such as PMS and booking engines, but our core focus is improving how hotel teams handle guest and group requests via email in their daily operations.
We are a small, international team working in a trust-based, remote-first environment where ownership, clarity, and direct communication matter more than hierarchy.
Job Summary
This is a client success role focused on helping hotel reservation and group sales teams adopt new ways of working, integrate our system into their daily operations, and build long-term, trusted relationships.
You will act as the main point of contact for your clients and ensure the system becomes part of their day-to-day workflow, particularly in how they manage and respond to inbound emails, enquiries, and group requests.
The role is about driving real usage and long-term value in operational environments — not sales and not technical implementation.
You should understand how hotels operate, especially reservation or sales departments, and be comfortable working with hotel systems and communication workflows.
Attitude & Culture
Since this is a fully remote position within a small but close-knit international team, we place strong importance on finding someone who is comfortable working independently, communicating clearly, and taking ownership of their responsibilities.
We work in a trust-based, non-micromanaged environment. You have flexibility in how and when you work, and in return we expect reliability, accountability, and good judgement in managing your clients and responsibilities.
